cohort: Migrant women who received CBD support in labor, migrant women who experienced usual care, and Swedish-born women giving birth during the same time period
finding: Community-based bilingual doula (CBD) support in migrant women was associated with reduced analgesia use but also showed an association with increased odds of emergency caesarean section and longer hospital stay after birth compared to Swedish-born women.
mod_finding: Nulliparous migrant women with CBD support had increased odds of emergency caesarean section compared to Swedish-born women.
